name: Rosaria
title: Thorny Benevolence
description: A sister of the church, though you wouldn't know it if it weren't for her attire. Known for her sharp, cold words and manner, she often works alone.

skills.name: Spear of the Church
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Ravaging Confession
skills.description:
Rosaria swiftly shifts her position to appear behind her opponent, then stabs and slashes them with her polearm, dealing Cryo DMG.
This ability cannot be used to travel behind opponents of a larger build.
skills.info: Those who confess to Sister Rosaria will be granted no absolution. All sinners shall be met with the piercing cold of punishment proportionate to the weight of their sins.

skills.name: Rites of Termination
skills.description:
Rosaria's unique take on this prayer ritual: First, she swings her weapon to slash surrounding opponents; then, she summons a frigid Ice Lance that strikes the ground. Both actions deal Cryo DMG.
While active, the Ice Lance periodically releases a blast of cold air, dealing Cryo DMG to surrounding opponents.
skills.info: Judgment is such a tedious ordeal — much easier to skip that phase and get straight to the last rites. Rosaria was never very devoted to the Anemo God anyway, which makes performing them all too easy.

passives.name: Regina Probationum
passives.description: When Rosaria strikes an opponent from behind using Ravaging Confession, Rosaria's CRIT Rate increases by 12% for 5s.

passives.name: Shadow Samaritan
passives.description:
Casting Rites of Termination increases CRIT Rate of all nearby party members (except Rosaria herself) by 15% of Rosaria's CRIT Rate for 10s.
CRIT Rate Bonus gained this way cannot exceed 15%.

passives.name: Night Walk
passives.description:
At night (18:00 – 06:00), your party members gain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD increased by 10%.
Does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.

constellations.name: Unholy Revelation
constellations.description: When Rosaria deals a CRIT Hit, her ATK SPD increases by 10% and her Normal Attack DMG increases by 10% for 4s.

constellations.name: Land Without Promise
constellations.description: The duration of the Ice Lance created by Rites of Termination is increased by 4s.

constellations.name: The Wages of Sin
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Ravaging Confession by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Painful Grace
constellations.description:
Ravaging Confession's CRIT Hits regenerate 5 Energy for Rosaria.
Can only be triggered once each time Ravaging Confession is cast.

constellations.name: Last Rites
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Rites of Termination by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Divine Retribution
constellations.description: Rites of Termination's attack decreases opponents' Physical RES by 20% for 10s.

outfits.name: To the Church's Free Spirit
outfits.description: Rosaria's outfit. This seems to have been custom-made for her by the Church.

outfits.name: Executor's Thorns
outfits.description: Rosaria's outfit. Rosaria has heavily modified this particular Church of Favonius uniform.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: Listen disciple, if you've got a problem you can't handle, then I'm the one for the job. But if you're looking for prayer, you'd better find some other Sister\n...Huh? You're not a disciple?

voices.title: Chat: Boredom
voices.text: Don't we have a job to do?

voices.title: Chat: Overtime
voices.text: Everything is negotiable, except overtime.

voices.title: Chat: Life in Mondstadt
voices.text: Work hard and live each day to the fullest. That is what life in Mondstadt is all about, isn't it?

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: This will slow things down.

voices.title: When Thunder Strikes
voices.text: ...What a nuisance.

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: We should keep moving, but watch your step in the snow.

voices.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voices.text: Blessings from the Anemo Archon Barsibato? Wait... no, it's Bartobas...?

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: *yawn* Good morning... I've missed morning mass, haven't I? Ugh, it starts too early anyway.

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: I'd say I sleep even better in the afternoon sun. You should try it sometime.

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: Good evening. Don't expect to see me at prayer tonight... And don't ask why.

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: Go ahead, take a break. I'll handle things here.

voices.title: About Rosaria: Sister
voices.text: Me? I'm just another ordinary person. Church, work... I just do what I have to do.

voices.title: About Rosaria: Troubles
voices.text: Each of the Sisters is worse than the next. If it's not about prayer, then it's about choir or some other thing I'm supposed to participate in... I'm trying to stay out of sight, so don't you dare tell them you saw me here.

voices.title: About Us: Beliefs
voices.text: Perhaps a god has the power to protect everyone if they would choose to do so, but that would never happen. Otherwise, people's suffering couldn't ever be taken seriously.

voices.title: About Us: Prayer
voices.text: Pray. Not for the gods, nor the betterment of others... but for yourself.

voices.title: About Us: Battle
voices.text: Don't overdo it. Let me take care of the dirty work.

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: A Vision... Could be proof of strength, or a medal for having survived... who knows? There're two sides to every coin. I won't limit my Vision with ceremonies and definitions. It witnesses me, and I witness it, that's all.

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: You don't always know why good things happen, or why we should be happy about them. Heh... But if you ever face a problem too big to handle, don't give up hope. You never know, someone may be there to help, even if you can't see them.

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: I take no interest in plant life and the sort, but the dandelion is an exception. How such a simple flower could turn into such a delectable wine is beyond me. A glass of dandelion wine after work is even better than sleeping in on Sunday.

voices.title: About Diluc
voices.text: Isn't it obvious? There's more than meets the eye to that rich tycoon. He's confident, yet discreet... and even a little bit dangerous.

voices.title: About Kaeya
voices.text: Wine has its uses... like revealing someone's true colors, for example. Smooth talk is Kaeya's veil, but being me, I can see right through it. Hah, you should see him when he's drunk.

voices.title: About Venti
voices.text: There's something extremely interesting about this bard... I can't quite put my finger on it. There's something that makes him different from the others in Mondstadt.

voices.title: About Barbara
voices.text: Barbara is like a thorn in my side, always nagging me about mass and choir practice. I wouldn't be surprised if Sister Victoria specifically asked her to keep an eye on me.

voices.title: About Jean
voices.text: She's not only competent in her own work but also somehow manages to clear up various matters for others... Huh. Now that's a woman who deserves admiration.

voices.title: About Albedo
voices.text: He's like an oil painting you find hanging on the wall in some ancient hall, profound and mysterious... hard to see through. But what can I say, I find people with stories... interesting.

voices.title: About Lisa
voices.text: Although I deplore those who play truant on a job, I respect her punctuality when it comes to closing up for the day.

voices.title: About Klee
voices.text: Trouble, and lots of it. Although, it is sort of a cute kind of trouble...

voices.title: About Varka
voices.text: I'm sure Varka means well, but his long-winded conversations get real old real quick. Although, he does really care for those around him, doesn't he?

voices.title: About Her Father
voices.text: Father? I'm not familiar with the word. You could say that I don't have one — could also say I have many, too. What's it to you?

voices.title: About Dahlia
voices.text: I like that he's in the habit of always offering to pick up the tab. In fact, his tavern etiquette in general is very good: He knows which questions he can ask and which ones to avoid. But since we figured each other out, I don't need to be too guarded around him anymore. It's so much easier to get along with people when they're smart like him.

voices.title: More About Rosaria: I
voices.text: Let's forgo the formalities. I'm here to finish a job. Just leave the dirty work to me.

voices.title: More About Rosaria: II
voices.text: What's weird about a Sister without reverence for the gods? There are hunters who don't eat pork, and fisherman who don't eat fish, aren't there? Just because you do something doesn't mean you love to do it. That's how every job goes.

voices.title: More About Rosaria: III
voices.text: This year's Dandelion Wine is sinfully good. Care for a glass?

voices.title: More About Rosaria: IV
voices.text: Mondstadt is a beast of light, both old and young. Old in the sense that it constantly requires someone's protection, yet too young to ever survive on its own. That's why there's people like me. I care for Mondstadt just as the other Sisters care for the believers, we are all guiding that which we love onward on the path towards freedom. Huh? Why do I call it a beast of light? Because people like myself can only be found in the dark...

voices.title: More About Rosaria: V
voices.text: I sometimes feel that my former selves from years past still exist alongside me, urging me on. I'm sure you know the feeling, too. Even if you decide to venture down a new path, don't just abandon the former you. For that is the foundation upon which you now take footing. Do not fear your past, and do not be scared to come to grips with it.

voices.title: Rosaria's Hobbies
voices.text: There are some troubles that only a stiff drink can take away. That being said, I never get drunk.

voices.title: Rosaria's Troubles
voices.text: Ugh, definitely skipping next month's choir concert, but I bet Sister Victoria will be personally taking roll... What a nuisance.

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: Have you ever tried Beef Bourguignon? Big chunks of meat with the smooth taste of alcohol... Mmm, it's delectable.

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: You mean I'm supposed to dip this hash brown in jam? Ugh, this is sacrilege!

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: It seems that our tastes are aligned when it comes to food.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: At least I'll be able to eat my fill with this.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: Do you really like this food?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Today's your birthday, so if you have any dirty work that needs taking care of, I can give you a hand... Just don't tell anybody, got it?

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: Hmm, just what I needed.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: You have a job for me? I've got time.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: Good. Getting stronger means finishing jobs quicker.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: I'm no stranger to spilling blood, but never have I possessed such power before. For such blessings, I give you thanks.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Hyah!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Judgment!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: You can't run!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Punishment!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Shiver!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: Lights out...

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: ...Hm, there are a few interesting trinkets here.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: I suppose it wasn't too much trouble.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: That felt... pretty good.

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: Hmph. Things are getting interesting...

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: Looks like overtime today.

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: So you know your stuff, huh?

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Let me handle this!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Don't try to be a hero!

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: At least... no more... work.

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: Maybe this is just... fate's dark design.

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: Is this... my final job?

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: I
voices.text: I see how it is.

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Ugh, what a nuisance!

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: I hear you've got a job for me.

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: Make sure to keep up.

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: Sooner we're done, the better.
